current_unit: Task 4: Prompter + media-library window managers characterization tests (modify tests/window-managers.test.ts)
notes: Task 3 complete: tests/window-managers.test.ts landed (url + slides window managers). Fixed two bugs found while correcting the plan's draft against real signatures: (1) the plan's draft called loadUrl('A', url, displayId) -- real signature is loadUrl(url, instance), 2 args, no displayId; per-instance display targeting is driven through store.setState({abState:{instanceA:{displayTarget}}}), not a loadUrl argument, so the 'explicit display target' test now initialize()s the manager and patches store state instead. (2) applying Task 2's single-test resetModules()-plus-reimport pattern across THREE tests in one file desynced the vi.mock('electron') factory's cached import from the test's own electronMock reference by the second test (each test passed in isolation, 2nd/3rd failed when run together) -- fixed by dropping vi.resetModules() entirely for this file (neither window manager holds module-level mutable state, so no fresh-module-instance-per-test is needed) and using a single top-level electronMock import plus beforeEach(electronMock.reset()) instead. IMPORTANT for Task 4: this file already exists and uses that top-level-import/no-resetModules pattern -- extend it the same way, do NOT introduce the plan's literal per-test resetModules() boilerplate into it. Verified npx tsc --noEmit clean and npx vitest run clean (1191/1191) except tests/companion-defs.test.ts, the same pre-existing unrelated packages/companion-module-pconair deps gap documented since Task 1. Per the roadmap, Task 4 is dispatched alone next firing, not concurrently with Tasks 5-9.
